title: A window that pours into the dock
blurb: Two <dialog> windows and a dock of buttons. Minimise a window and it bends into a funnel and pours into its button, drawn as strips 2 pixels tall. The windows hold real form controls, which keep their state while they're away.
question: The macOS genie effect bends a window into a funnel. Can a 2D canvas do it to a <dialog> with one source-rectangle draw for each row, and is the window's hit box right when it comes back?
result: Yes, three ways: a source rectangle for each row, a clip for each row, or strips copied from one picture of the window. All ran at 60 paints a second in the test browser. On a phone the first was slow, so the page starts on the copy. A strip drawn from the element moves its hit box, and one whole draw restores it.
